technical_and_design_decisions: Use existing Spring Boot configuration and actuator extension points wherever possible instead of introducing parallel Spring XD-specific mechanisms.

Implement job-module context creation lazily at job launch and dispose of the module application context after successful or failed completion, with lifecycle cleanup guaranteed through finally-style handling.
Expose module and application metrics through the Spring Boot actuator MetricRepository API and preserve existing metric naming and tagging conventions where compatible.
Represent module options as Spring Boot property sources and generate or maintain configuration metadata so tooling can discover available options.
Use a centralized external configuration repository or service with server-side loading and client-side bootstrap integration for XD-Admin and XD-Container.
Evaluate Rabbit performance using repeatable throughput, latency, resource-utilization, and message-size benchmarks before selecting a targeted configuration or code change.
Migrate CI jobs to managed EC2 build instances while retaining equivalent build steps, test coverage, artifact publication, and log retention.
Publish benchmark results with hardware, operating system, JVM, cluster topology, configuration, workload, and measurement methodology details.
Treat documentation and examples as versioned deliverables and validate them against the implemented Spark streaming behavior.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase, build system, test infrastructure, and deployment scripts are available and buildable without a major dependency upgrade.
The increment is implemented by one developer, and estimates represent hands-on work-hours rather than elapsed calendar time.
Existing Spring Boot actuator and configuration APIs can be adopted with limited compatibility adaptation; a new actuator subsystem is not required.
The job lifecycle change applies to the existing job-module deployment model and does not require redesigning the scheduler, transport protocol, or cluster orchestration.
The Spark work consists of adding or documenting output taps, updating representative examples, and documenting Reliable receiver behavior; it does not include upgrading Spark itself.
The centralized configuration capability can reuse an existing repository or service pattern and does not require building a highly available production configuration platform from scratch.
Rabbit investigation is limited to one representative performance bottleneck and its corrective change, followed by regression benchmarking.

The EC2 CI migration covers the master-branch build pipeline, including provisioning, configuration, credentials, build execution, and basic operational documentation, but not a complete enterprise CI redesign.
Testing includes unit, integration, regression, and focused performance validation appropriate to each change, with existing automated test frameworks reused.
No substantial security certification, legal review, localization, or third-party vendor procurement effort is included.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the relevant Spring XD modules, current lifecycle, metrics, configuration, Spark, Rabbit, and CI implementations; refine interfaces, identify impacted tests, and define implementation and validation plans for all user stories.

Define representative Spring XD cluster workloads, execute benchmarks, capture infrastructure and software configuration, analyze results, and publish reproducible benchmark documentation and artifacts.

Change job-module lifecycle handling so the application context is created when a job is launched and closed when execution completes, including failure cleanup, concurrency handling, lifecycle state management, and automated tests.

activities.activity_name: Spark streaming taps and documentation updates
activities.activity_description: Implement or expose the required tap behavior at Spark module output, update Spark streaming examples, and add documentation describing Reliable receiver configuration, behavior, limitations, and operational considerations.

Integrate module and application-specific metrics with the Spring Boot actuator MetricRepository API, adapt metric publication and consumption paths, preserve useful identifiers, and add unit and integration coverage.

Move module option resolution to pure Spring Boot property-source management, remove or bypass duplicated core-runtime classpath option handling, add configuration metadata, and validate precedence, defaults, and backward compatibility.

Implement the shared external-property management approach and integrate server-side and client-side loading for XD-Admin and XD-Container, including environment selection, precedence rules, error handling, documentation, and tests.

activities.activity_name: Rabbit message-bus performance investigation and correction
activities.activity_description: Create a repeatable Rabbit benchmark, profile throughput and latency across relevant configuration dimensions, isolate the principal bottleneck, implement the targeted fix or tuning change, and verify performance and regression behavior.

Provision and configure EC2 build instances, migrate master-branch jobs and dependencies, transfer credentials and artifact handling, validate parallel and failure behavior, and document maintenance and recovery procedures.

activities.activity_name: Cross-feature integration, regression testing, and defect correction
activities.activity_description: Run the full build and focused integration suites, validate interactions among lifecycle, configuration, metrics, messaging, Spark, and deployment changes, correct discovered defects, and perform final performance and compatibility checks.

activities.activity_name: Release packaging and final technical documentation
activities.activity_description: Assemble release notes, migration guidance, configuration references, benchmark and operational documentation, verify examples and generated metadata, and prepare the completed increment for review and delivery.
